interactives.label: Rules of the arcades
interactives.text: One party at a time. The tide brings them to you; the streets behind stay quiet once you have cleared them. Fall and you rise at the last fire you passed. The waystones count you out.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The bell-ringers' steps
interactives.text: The ringers climbed out of the flood here to dry their ropes. One rope is still tied to the rail.

interactives.label: The customs house's last strongbox
interactives.text: The road's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.
